    StartersFrank the Tank's wingsCrisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dipHow to make it1kg chicken wings60g butter80ml hot sauce1 tbsp honey80g blue cheese150g sour cream3 celery sticksDry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings.Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream to dip.Serve with celery sticks.Pledge week jalapeño poppersJalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and bakedHow to make it12 jalapenos150g cream cheese60g cheddar12 rashers of baconHalve and seed the jalapenos.Mix the cream cheese with the grated cheddar and fill each half.Wrap in half a rasher of bacon each.Bake at 200°C until the bacon is crisp.Mitch-a-Palooza smash sliders in paperThe housewarming party at Mitch's houseHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin crispy smashed beef patties with melted American cheese, pickles, diced onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, wrapped in paper.Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls.Mix 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for sauce.Heat a griddle until smoking, smash the balls thin, season and cook 90 seconds, flip and top with half a slice of American cheese.Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patty, sauce, pickles and finely diced onion.Wrap each in a square of baking paper.Buffalo chicken dipYou're my boy, Blue. Saved you a scoop.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsBackyard brisketDry rubbed brisket cooked 8 hours until it wobbles, with white bread and picklesHow to make it2kg beef brisket2 tbsp salt2 tbsp cracked black pepper1 tbsp smoked paprika1 loaf white bread1 jar dill pickles1 bottle barbecue sauceRub the brisket with salt, pepper and paprika.Wrap tightly.Cook at 140°C until it wobbles.Rest for an hour.Slice thick and serve with white bread, pickles and barbecue sauce.Frank's wedding chicken with mushroom sauceFrank's wedding at the startHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken breasts pan-roasted in butter and thyme with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, buttery mash and green beans.Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in 30g butter for 4 minutes a side, then roast at 200°C for 10 minutes and rest.In the same pan fry 300g sliced mushrooms and a chopped shallot, add 125ml white wine and reduce, then 200ml cream and thyme and simmer 3 minutes.Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk.Steam 300g green beans.Slice the chicken and spoon over the sauce.SweetsFrat house sheet cakeChocolate tray cake covered in chocolate buttercreamHow to make it350g butter250g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour90g cocoa200ml full cream milk300g icing sugar1 jar sprinklesBeat part of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, part of the cocoa and the milk.Bake in a tray at 175°C.Cool.Beat the remaining butter, icing sugar and cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.DrinksFrank's lemonade punch, ice includedBourbon, lemon and peach nectar punch topped with cold lagerHow to make it200ml bourbon4 lemons60ml sugar syrup500ml peach nectar750ml cold lager1 bunch mint1 bag iceStir the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and peach nectar in a big bowl.Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with lager.Float lemon wheels and mint on top and ladle into red plastic cups.Cold keg lager in red cupsFrank!
